get.description: Public, no login required — this is the token board patients check.

post.description: Staff only. See PriorityRequest — no symptom/clinical field exists here.

get.description:
Server-Sent Events stream of QueueSnapshotOut updates, one event per
recompute. See docs/api-contract.md § Live for event types and payload shape.
Left ungated like GET /api/status/{token_no}: the public status page consumes
this without login, same as staff dashboards do while authenticated.

post.description:
Wraps app.core.clock.freeze — added for the console's Freeze/Resume
controls; the underlying clock logic is already implemented and unit-tested
(see backend/tests/test_clock.py), only the HTTP surface is still M8.

PriorityRequest.title: PriorityRequest
PriorityRequest.description:
Staff-only. There is no symptom or clinical field here or anywhere in the
API — priority is an explicit operational decision, never inferred.

ProviderQueueSummaryOut.title: ProviderQueueSummaryOut
ProviderQueueSummaryOut.description: One row of GET /api/queue/overview — summary only, no per-visit detail.

PublicStatusOut.title: PublicStatusOut
PublicStatusOut.description:
Response for the public, no-login token lookup. Deliberately excludes
patient_name/phone and any other provider's queue state.

QueueEventType.title: QueueEventType
QueueEventType.description:
Fixed event vocabulary — every one of these, and only these, may mutate a Visit
and must be followed by engine.recompute(provider, now). See docs/architecture.md.

QueueSnapshotOut.title: QueueSnapshotOut
QueueSnapshotOut.description:
Full live state of one provider's queue. Returned by
GET /api/queue/providers/{id} and pushed over SSE on every recompute.

QueueVisitOut.title: QueueVisitOut
QueueVisitOut.description: One entry in a provider's live queue, as returned inside QueueSnapshotOut.

VisitOut.title: VisitOut
VisitOut.description:
Shared representation of a visit, returned by booking, walk-in, and lifecycle
endpoints. Never includes patient contact details beyond what the caller's role
is entitled to — the public status endpoint uses PublicStatusOut instead.

provider_id.title: Provider Id
provider_id.description: If omitted, auto-routed to the least-loaded active provider offering this service in the department (docs/architecture.md § load balancer).
